name: add_ts_trie_autocomplete
description: Implements a prefix-tree (Trie) supporting insertion and alphabetically-sorted prefix lookup
prompts: Create trie.ts exporting a class Trie with insert(word: string): void, which adds word to the trie, and wordsWithPrefix(prefix: string): string[], which returns every previously-inserted word that starts with prefix, sorted alphabetically ascending. An empty prefix must return ALL inserted words (sorted). A prefix with no matches returns an empty array. A word that is itself a prefix of another inserted word (e.g. both "car" and "care" are inserted) must be returned correctly for both wordsWithPrefix("car") (includes both) and exact lookups. Do not return duplicate entries if the same word is inserted more than once.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit trie.ts type_tests.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build trie.ts
node behavior_test.js
